ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel distribution across >95% of the visible surface area; high-intensity (white) pixels are sparse and restricted to localized scars and anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation field. High-contrast white features include a distinct circular annulus on the right lobe (medial region) and scattered punctate white spots. Linear white pixel clusters are concentrated at the lower central base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate pixel angle of 35 degrees between adjacent lobe edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with multiple irregular peaks and valleys. The most prominent jagged edges are localized on the distal thirds of both trailing boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curvature starting from the median notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured white pixel clusters at both distal tips indicating barnacle colonization. Numerous small, isolated circular white spots are scattered across the dark pigment of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, white unaligned linear marks are visible, primarily concentrated in the lower-central region and middle of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle accumulation at both fluke tips. A highly distinctive white circular ring scar is present on the right lobe. Multiple white rake marks or scratches are distributed across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The well-defined white ring-shaped scar on the medial-right lobe is a unique identification marker.
